title: The Star Wheel and the Bound Archons
description: There are four registers in which the proprium has been distributed and held — bound powers in the upper degrees, the natural mind below, the settled disorders ringing the natural, and the recurrent circuit itself. The fourth — the turning Wheel — bears what could not be bound above and could not be fixed in the lower mountains: the firstborn shapes of the proprium, set to revolve so that good and truth from below may be received and lifted as they pass through, and so that what falls from above may be carried by the same revolution and cast over the whole natural ground. The proprium organized as ruling principle is bound to this turning together with all its arrayed strivings and its counterfeit beauty, hung opposite one another in single accord, set to revolve until each region has had its share in the work.
